tool.name: SSI Ambiguous Sites
tool.description: count ambiguous SNV sites from reads mapped to a supplied assembly
tool.command: #import re #set $clean_sample = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9._-]', '_', str($sample_name)) mkdir -p outputs && ssiamb self --r1 '$r1' --r2 '$r2' --assembly '$assembly' --sample '$clean_sample' --outdir outputs --threads \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} --dp-min '$thresholds.dp_min' --maf-min '$thresholds.maf_min' --dp-cap '$thresholds.dp_cap' #if $advanced.bbtools_mem --bbtools-mem '$advanced.bbtools_mem' #end if #if $advanced.keep_intermediates --keep-intermediates #end if

param.name: assembly
param.label: Shovill assembly
param.help: Assembly produced upstream, for example by Shovill.

param.name: sample_name
param.label: Sample name
param.help: Used in reports and output filenames.

param.name: bbtools_mem
param.label: BBTools heap size
param.help: Optional value without -Xmx prefix, for example 4g.

tool.help: `ssiamb` expects trimmed paired-end reads and a supplied assembly. It maps the reads back to the assembly, calls variants with BBTools, groups same-position VCF records, and counts ambiguous SNV loci using depth and minor allele frequency thresholds.
